description: This file defines the `ShortcutTemplateListFragment` class, which extends `BaseActivityListFragment`. It manages launching activities related to shortcut configuration and handles the result of shortcut pinning requests within an Android application, specifically in the context of shortcut management APIs.

classes.name: ShortcutTemplateListFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list of shortcut templates, launches shortcut configuration activities, and handles their results.

methods.name: getActivities
methods.description: Retrieves a list of launcher activities related to shortcut configuration for a specific user.

methods.name: onLaunch
methods.description: Starts the shortcut configuration activity for the given launcher activity info.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the shortcut configuration activity, including accepting pin requests or showing error toasts.
